alignments.note: καί is intensive here and is realized by “verily.”
The negative particle is realized by “not.”
The inflected verb licenses “hath been made glorious”; the lexical anchor is “glorious.”
The substantival article supplies the antecedent pronoun “that” before the participle.
The participle is expanded as “which hath been made glorious,” headed on “glorious.”
The article has no separate realization because the demonstrative occupies the English determiner slot.

The improper preposition εἵνεκεν governs the genitive only and never compounds as a verbal prefix, so rule 71 settles the frame “by reason of” on its lexical noun “reason” and rule 67's division, which is confined to proper prepositions, does not reach it. The morph tag does not distinguish the classes: ἐνώπιον is tagged PREP too and heads on “sight” or “presence” throughout. REV.14.10 is the structural twin, giving ἐνώπιον the whole frame including the trailing “of” and leaving the following article a bare “the.”
The attributive participle is expanded as the relative clause “that surpasseth.”
